description: Source code for the Flatbuffer loader used in PyTorch JIT mobile module serialization/deserialization, including class definitions, parsing functions, and module loading utilities.

classes.name: FlatbufferLoader
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing Flatbuffer serialized modules into PyTorch mobile modules, managing internal state, and providing parsing utilities.

methods.name: registerIValueParser
methods.description: Registers a parser function for a specific IValue type.

methods.name: internal_registerTypeResolver
methods.description: Sets the type resolver function used during type parsing.

methods.name: getIValue
methods.description: Retrieves an IValue at a specified position.

methods.name: getFunction
methods.description: Retrieves a Function pointer at a specified position.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Retrieves a ClassTypePtr at a specified position.

methods.name: getStorage
methods.description: Returns a c10::Storage object at a given index, loading it if necessary.

methods.name: getOrCreateTypeAnnotations
methods.description: Resolves or creates type annotations from a string offset.

methods.name: getOrCreateClassTypeForObject
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a ClassType for a given serialized object.

methods.name: parseIValue
methods.description: Parses an IValue from a serialized representation.

methods.name: parseFunction
methods.description: Parses a Function object from serialized data.

methods.name: parseAndPopulate
methods.description: Parses an IValue or Function and populates internal storage.

methods.name: parseModule
methods.description: Parses a serialized module into a PyTorch Module object.

methods.name: extractJitSourceAndConstants
methods.description: Extracts JIT source code and constants from the module.
